statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote-modules.c decodes accelerometer X/Y/Z counts from input reports and subtracts a fixed 0x200 bias when emitting ABS_RX, ABS_RY and ABS_RZ through evdev. Its Y and Z data contain only nine meaningful bits because their lowest bits are unavailable. This handler does not apply EEPROM calibration. This is host-side report processing, not measured factory calibration.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-wiimote-modules.c:425-457 (unpack, Y/Z precision and 0x200 subtraction),500-506 (evdev axes/ranges). No EEPROM calibration in this input handler.
